title: Replicating SHADE-Arena with an Explicit Monitor Prompt Optimized for Open-Source Agents

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: prompt engineering for open-source models improves monitoring. However, the finding would be somewhat incremental - it is expected that prompts need tuning for different models. The safety implication is real but not deeply surprising.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires running SHADE-Arena infrastructure with Llama-3.1-8B as agent, which involves complex agentic task setup. Prompt optimization on agent traces adds another layer. The infrastructure burden is substantial for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Two prompt conditions is conceptually simple, but setting up SHADE-Arena and running agents on tasks could easily exceed 30 hours for infrastructure alone.
